title: T&T Together: Glow in Motion 5K
summary: A glow-themed evening 5K in St Clair for runners, walkers and joggers, with a finisher’s medal and prizes.
description: Glow-themed 5K on Saturday 3 October 2026 at The Mecca, 11A Maraval Road, with arrival from 5:00 PM. The organiser describes it as suitable for running, walking or jogging. Registration is TT$175 and the live Race Roster page advertises a finisher’s medal and more than TT$20,000 in prizes. This is the rescheduled date.
